metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.1 · 1997 · Cube
metas.description: A group of strangers awaken to find themselves placed in a giant cube. Each one of them is gifted with a special skill and they must work together to escape an endless maze of deadly traps.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.5 · 2002 · Cube²: Hypercube
metas.description: Eight strangers awaken with no memory, in a puzzling cube-shaped room where the laws of physics do not always apply.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.6 · 2004 · Cube Zero
metas.description: A young programmer whose job is to watch over the reality-warping Cube defies orders to rescue an innocent mother trapped in one of its rooms.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 4.5 · 2021 · Cube
metas.description: In this remake, without remembering how they got there, several strangers awaken in a prison of cubic cells, some of them booby-trapped. The prisoners must use their combined skills if they are to escape.
